Name: Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic - Male Farmer Fix
Author: zzjay
Description:
Fixes an issue related to the male farmer walking animation, while using this mod:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450?tab=description]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic[/url]

Vanilla (base game) farmer is NOT affected by this bug.
Female farmer was not affected by this bug.
The bug only appears while using the aformentioned mod.

[b]I noticed that while walking upwards, the legs of the male farmer tended to show from the pants, this fixes the problem.[/b]

----------------------------------------------
[color=#f6b26b]
[/color][b][color=#f6b26b]INSTALLATON GUIDE[/color]

[/b]Install:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1437?tab=description]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic[/url]

Then install this mod, and say "yes", when prompted to merge and [b]replace[/b] files.

This mod will have no effect in your game, unless [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1437?tab=description]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic[/url] is installed, and the BASE FARMER option is active in that mod config file.

--------------------------------------------

It's not a mod itself, but a small bugfix, of an existing mod that affected male farmer.
